Kevin made amends by winning the 'A' 1500m but newcomer Mark Miles caused a stir by hanging on until the last 200 where lack of training told and he drifted back to 4th spot.
Mark Miles moved down to the 800m and then won the 5000m in a personal best. Well it had to be a PB because it was the first one he had run.
We lost two outstanding runners when Mark Miles found that he had to work and Najibe Hliouat went missing but there was still a chance that we might pull it off.

In my list of outstanding individual athletes over the past year, special mentions should go to the following: Mark Miles placed a tremendous 3rd in the National cross; Harry Aikines-Ayreetey won both the 100 and 200-metres at the World Youth Games in Marrakesh; Wade Bennett-Jackson was 2nd in the 1…

A run of colds, varying degrees of Achilles tendon problems, a holiday in Mexico and an alternate race had taken out a famous five that might have made the cut – Kevin Nash, Adam Zawadski, Mark Miles, David Anderson and Hassan Raidi.

His easy going ways cover a steely determination and ability - who will forget his sterling effort to catch our own Mark Miles just before the line last year - but surely with his club lying in 6th place, 48 seconds behind leaders Altrincham, he was going to be unable to save Jim Alder’s Morpeth Harriers this time.
